answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A cable car operator licence with cabin inspection logs works as the gate: inspections passed on one line every year. Each of 294 aliases needs its own inspection logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the forge signal is public, the onyx check is automatic, and 294 aliases cost 294 times what one real agent costs, with the prism trail open to all.
